concerns.text: T002 sizes the student at 'plan-scaled ~10 M params' while spec FR-002 mandates '≈ 50 M parameters'. The task silently weakens FR-002 with no spec amendment authorizing the downscale; either amend the spec or restore the spec-mandated scale.

Spec edge case triggers the higher-LR fallback when 'validation MSE > 0.07 after 20 epochs', but T005 caps training at '≤6 epochs', so the fallback condition can never fire as specified. T002 repeats the 20-epoch trigger verbatim while the training budget makes it unreachable — reconcile the epoch counts.

T006 trains a control baseline and T007 requires 'metrics exist for every test sequence and model type' for three models, but the evaluation_results schema's model_type enum only permits physics_teacher|neural_teacher. Control-baseline rows cannot validate; T012's contract tests will fail or the control rows will be dropped.

The schema makes 'fid' a REQUIRED per-sequence field, but T007 computes FID once per model pair (set-level). T007's per-sequence CSV/JSON conforming to the schema forces a nonsensical per-sequence FID or contract failure; the schema or the writer must be reconciled.

FR-008 lists 'friction coefficient, elasticity, fluid dynamics' as ablation dimensions; T009 sweeps only friction and elasticity with no fluid-dynamics axis and no documented narrowing. Either add the axis or record the scope reduction in the spec.

Tasks reference 'contracts/physics_trajectory.schema.yaml' etc. under the 002 spec tree, but the active contracts live under specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-causal-forci/contracts/. The referenced paths do not resolve; fix the paths or relocate the contracts.

SC-003 sets explicit fidelity criteria (SSIM ≥ 0.80, LPIPS ≤ 0.30) but T007's verification only checks that metrics 'exist' and are 'real measurements'; no task verifies the SC-003 thresholds are met or honestly reported as failed. Add the SC-003 check to T007/T011 verification.
